roles.name: Deep Marshal
powers: If you fail a check to defeat a non-villain monster (☐ or barrier) when playing a weapon or a spell, you may (☐ reduce its damage by 2, and/or) after the encounter put the bane on top of the deck it came from.
When you would banish a barrier you encounter (☐ or a character at your location would banish a barrier he encounters), you may draw it instead.

You may banish a barrier from your hand (☐ to recharge a random weapon or spell from your discard pile or) to add 1d8 plus its adventure deck number to your check to defeat a monster (☐ or a barrier).
☐ You may banish a barrier from your hand or discard pile to draw a card (☐ or to explore your location).
☐ You may add your Strength skill to your (☐ or a character at your location's) check to defeat a barrier.
☐ You may reveal Magus Arcana to succeed at your check to recharge a spell.

roles.name: Spell Trapper
powers: If you fail (☐ or another character at your location fails) a check to defeat a non-villain monster (☐ or barrier) when playing a weapon or a spell, you may (☐ reduce its damage by 2, and/or) after the encounter (☐ you may reset your hand then encounter it or) put the bane on top of the deck it came from.
When you would banish a barrier you encounter, you may draw it instead.

You may banish a barrier from your hand (☐ to recharge a random weapon or spell from your discard pile or) to add its 1d8 plus its adventure deck number to your check to defeat a monster (☐ or barrier).
☐ When you fail a check, you may draw a barrier from the box or draw a random card from your discard pile (☐ or draw both).
☐ You may put Magus Arcana on top of your deck to add your Disable skill to your check (☐ or a check by a character at your location).
